evidence.name: Screen field: Gap between icon and text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Gap between icon and text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Gap between icon and text
sections.description: Sets the horizontal space between the field's icon and the text the visitor types (default 8 pixels). The default works for most fields — nudge it up a little if the icon and text feel cramped, or down for a tighter look. The goal is an icon and placeholder that sit comfortably balanced.
